szenen.text: A viral post says BlackRock is dumping hundreds of millions in Bitcoin and Ether. Real or panic? We checked the data.
Do the math. 34 million dollars for 300 Bitcoin is 113 thousand dollars per coin. And 42.7 million for 10 thousand Ether is 4,269 dollars.

szenen.text_ohne: Bitcoin today is far below that. Not even close.

szenen.text: So the screenshot is old. And coins moving to Coinbase Prime are how BlackRock's ETFs handle redemptions, not a secret dump. What is real: nearly 3 billion dollars left the bitcoin ETFs in two weeks. Follow for facts, not fear.
